prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: All ten lambda gains +.0864…+.1191 and source Tc+3.400 K accompany positive optical Gamma, no printed path negatives, fine force .01216 eV/A and stress .041 GPa. Separate primary Tc-binary calculations find no ordered Mo-Tc ground states, a concrete decomposition/order competition. This source-positive local metastable basin is admissible only as a metastable phase research object, not equilibrium proof.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 4.473719870440352e-05 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.012160290516801547 eV/Å, pressure 0.022 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re-to-Tc role construction in tetragonal Mo2X. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare the exact ordered SG139 source phase with the nearest saved Mo-Tc competitor or explicitly known disordered branch. Favorable: local basin and useful paired response persist under a feasible metastable preparation hypothesis; adverse: direct phase competition rules out accessible retained phase; ambiguous: no comparable formation information.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
